questions.question_text:
$4^{3}=64$, $4^{2}=16$ and $4^{1}=4$.
Continuing the pattern by dividing by $4$ each time, what is $4^{0}$?

options.why: Assumed a zero index means nothing is left, so the value drops to zero.
Stopped the pattern at $4^{1}$ and repeated its value instead of dividing once more.
Continued the pattern one step too far, giving the value of the next index down.
